name: Enchantment Descriptions
qol: Enchanted book tooltips explain each enchantment's effect (e.g. Protection: reduces damage from most sources)
getting_started: Hover over an enchanted book in your inventory or at an enchanting table/anvil to read the description.
editor_notes: Client-side. Requires the Prickle library. Modrinth says descriptions appear on enchanted books; it does not say they appear on enchanted gear.
summary: Adds a short description of what each enchantment does to the tooltip of enchanted books. Covers all vanilla enchantments and many modded ones.
